rating.comments: The student gives a bare estimate of 2000 students and then a per-student figure of 1.5 litres, with a brief condition: "5 days a week so not in the weekends". They correct an earlier error ("sorry I did a mistake") but never multiply the components into a total, so reasoning stays at a brief-reason level. Their own estimates are applied to the problem, with no new information or transfer. They ask no questions, and their several task-focused contributions show moderate effort.
